name: FlawPilot
description: FlawPilot connects Claude to your website health scans. Ask Claude to scan any live URL, and FlawPilot checks it for security vulnerabilities, performance bottlenecks, infrastructure issues, and SEO problems. Claude can list your existing projects, queue a new scan against one of them, and check scan status until results are ready, complete with prioritized scores you can act on right away, all without leaving your conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add FlawPilot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add FlawPilot to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.flawpilot.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the FlawPilot MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: FlawPilot provides these MCP tools: get_scan_status, list_projects, and trigger_scan.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to FlawPilot?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to FlawPilot in other on the Manufact MCP catalog include Muju, ZMAXINC, PGA – Play Golf, citytracker.ai, and Commonlands Optics: M12 Lens and C-Mount Lens Finder + Field-of-View Calculator.
FlawPilot requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
FlawPilot is developed by LOGICWIND TECHNOLOGIES LLP. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
